sn45.40:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Brahmacariyaṃ ca vo bhikkhave desissāmi brahmacariyatthañ ca || || taṃ suṇātha || || Katamañ ca bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ || ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo || seyyathīdaṃ || sammādiṭṭhi || la || sammāsamādhi || || Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ || || Katamo ca bhikkhave brahmacariyattho || Yo kho bhikkhave rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo || || Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave brahmacariyatthoti || || Paṭipattivaggo catuttho || || Sabbam eva
sn45.40:2.0: Sāvatthinidānaṃ || || Tassa uddānaṃ || || Paṭipatti Patipanno ca || || Viraddhañ ca Pāraṅgamā || Sāmaññena dve vuttā || Brahmaññā aparo duve || Brahmacariyena dve vuttā || Vaggo tena pavuccatī ti
